review.rationale: The Recommendation correctly identifies that CE-G12 has completed its technical validation phases (preserved artifact activation, public route validation, network path attribution) but the five canonical commercialization status surfaces remain stale at CURRENT_TARGET_CLASSIFICATION_DECISION_REQUIRED. Option A appropriately reconciles the exact current state by updating only the five specified paths while preserving historical failures (preflight fail-closed, atomic deployment route-hash failure, rollback), maintaining the critical distinction between application surface exactness (APPLICATION_SURFACE_EXACT=true) and direct-origin validation (STRICT_DIRECT_ORIGIN_PATH_PASS=false due to LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DNS_MAPPING_OBSERVED), and keeping all commercialization/production/release flags false. The validation contract is comprehensive with 10 explicit checks including historical failure preservation, schema validation, and cross-file consistency. CE-G13 is correctly positioned as a future Recommendation for independent agent discovery/reuse validation rather than execution, with explicit non-authorization of that work in this action. The five-path scope is sound and necessary to prevent cockpit staleness that would misroute future agents. All authority boundaries are preserved with explicit non-authorizations covering deployment, release, commercial offering, and operational changes.
